svg.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif
svg.title: The Wine-Dark Sea
svg.desc: the isles of the wanderings, from Troy to Ithaca, as the poem has them — generated by tools/draw-map.mjs from data/maps/wine-dark-sea.json. A flat terrain colour per hex, a coastline, the settlements and the lanes between them. No hex grid: that is an overlay drawn at read time from the same rows, so it cannot disagree with this.
